scores.name: Route Band Signage
scores.note: Bands encode footprint without a word of explanation; flat plates project cleanly and nobody mistakes signage for AI art. Pure CSS build. Watch sternness.

scores.name: Lagoon After Dark
scores.note: Loudest slide in the room: magenta poster type on navy. Off-peak night walking is a credible Gulf sustainability lever. Needs real night photos tonight.

scores.name: Girih Screen
scores.note: Lattice-as-mask is the most memorable concept and the hardest build; animated khatam SVG masks will eat the afternoon. Teal-brass flirts with hotel brochure.

scores.name: Hashiya Folio
scores.note: Marginalia is the cleverest idea here but invisible at projector distance; hairlines and 14px notes vanish, sustainability is a footnote ledger. Brochure risk is real.

scores.name: Mleiha Field Sheet
scores.note: Carbon ticket ledger is concrete, but stamps read as badges, which last year's winner built. Halftone and MapLibre recolor cost hours; twin of Khor.

scores.name: Coral Reticle
scores.note: Sustainability row in every callout is the best theme integration here, but glass HUD on camera is exactly what AI renders. Heading jitter will show.

scores.name: Khor Field Guide
scores.note: Strongest conservation story, weakest deliverability: species plates will not exist by 18:00 and muted sage washes out on a projector. Twin of Mleiha.

scores.name: Gypsum Hour
scores.note: Big serif over desaturated photos is the default AI travel brand; shade hatching is a thin sustainability story. Easy to build, easy to forget.
